node.title: Programme Bridge Note — Map, Flow, Epistemic Distance and the Lineage to Ecosystem Positioning
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: 1. Why this note exists · 2. The programme root: Map and Flow · 2.1 A more precise formulation.

relations: The programme bridge extends the map–flow reading while keeping analytical closure distinct from causal isolation and its provisional topology separate from established results.
No se afirma una distancia medida, una ley de conservación física ni una topología formal ya demostrada.
